content.text: Four of five EQE measurements are used. The best values so far are about 0.11% at Sb 0.16 and at Sb 0.39. I'm using the last measurement on Sb 0.45 (index 22), near the Sb = 0.5 phases.

input.rationale: Highest measured EQE was 0.111% at Sb=0.394 (index 20). Index 10 (Sb=0.157) was about equal at 0.110%. The response across the line is low and flat: 0.095 at Sb 0.26, 0.102 at Sb 0.45 and 0.074 at Sb 0.63.

content.text:
I submitted index 20 (Sb fraction 0.394) as the best composition. At 0.111% EQE it was the highest I measured, but only barely, and all five compositions gave low EQE.

| Index | Sb fraction | EQE (%) |
|---|---|---|
| 10 | 0.157 | 0.110 |
| 15 | 0.259 | 0.095 |
| 20 | 0.394 | **0.111** |
| 22 | 0.451 | 0.102 |
| 28 | 0.630 | 0.074 |

- **Close call:** index 10 is within 0.001 of index 20. I didn't take repeat measurements, so I can't say whether that gap is bigger than measurement noise. The two are effectively tied.
- **Untested range:** nothing below Sb 0.157 was measured (indices 0–9). The last Gaussian-process suggestion put the three lowest-Sb compositions (indices 0–2) among its top five picks. A better composition could be there, and the score only counts compositions I actually measured.
- **No XRD:** I didn't use any of the 5 XRD measurements. The rationale I submitted says the dip at index 15 is "near Y3SbO7 composition". That only means its Sb fraction (0.26) is close to 0.25; I never confirmed which crystal phases are present.
